# Human Lead

## What it means

The Human Lead is the person the [AI Space](./ai-space.md) belongs to and who takes its decisions.

The Human Lead can ask a session for anything at any moment, and the session does it. A spec, a planned item and the processes are offered to the Human Lead and are not required.

## Where it is kept

No file describes the Human Lead. What the Human Lead decides is recorded where the decision applies. A confirmed claim and the answer to a gate are in the desk's records, which the companion keeps. An agreed spec is in a publish area. A decision about how the Space works is a change to the Lore.

## What acts on it

No verb acts on the Human Lead. The Human Lead is the one who confirms that a session enters [Writing](./writing.md), answers every [gate](./gate.md), declares a [spec](./spec.md) agreed, moves a [unit of work](./unit-of-work.md) from one stage to the next, and changes the Lore, which is the pillar [Shaping](./shaping.md).
